note: The pop-up of every heading of the claims list, and the plain reason shown under an extraction confidence value (one line per check or flag word the server names in confidence.failed). One file; George checks the wording here.
label_mismatch_question: The app could not confidently link this figure to its label. Which label describes it?

columns.Type: What the figure measures, such as Revenue, ARR, Customers or Market size. A segment appears after the type, for example ‘Revenue · Platform Subscriptions’. ‘Part of ARR 2025 total’ means this figure is a component of a total reported elsewhere. ‘Other’ means the app has not classified it as a company claim, so it is excluded from the register. Use Edit to change the classification.
columns.Value: The value extracted from the deck, including its unit or currency. Ranges show a lower and upper bound. For a table row covering several periods, values are shown by period. If the currency differs from the audit currency, hover over the value to see the conversion.
columns.Period: The date or period assigned to the figure, such as ‘Q3 2025’ or ‘Dec 2025’. ‘No date’ means no period was identified; use Edit to add one. A note explains when the period comes from a heading or another cell.
columns.Claim in the deck: The source text containing the figure. ‘Label from’ shows the source text used to identify what the figure measures. ‘Date from’ shows the source text used to identify its period. These excerpts reproduce the deck’s wording.
columns.Source: The file and the slide or page the figure was read from, with the table, row and column or the cell. Multiple source entries mean the app linked this claim to more than one location.
columns.Extraction confidence: How confidently the app extracted and linked the figure to its source. This does not verify the company’s claim. High: the figure was found and all extraction checks passed. Medium: the figure was found, but an assumption, note or failed check needs review. Low: the figure could not be located, a review flag was raised, or two or more checks failed. Analyst-entered and analyst-edited claims are not scored.
columns.Status: Needs your attention: review is required before the claim can enter the register. In the register: the claim is included for testing against available evidence. Inclusion does not mean it has been verified. Entered by the app: the app added the claim automatically after its extraction checks passed. Edited: you changed the claim’s details. Rejected: the claim is excluded from use but retained on record. Claims marked “Entered by the app” or “Edited” are also in the register.
columns.Action: Keep (tick): accept this as a company claim for inclusion in the register and testing against available evidence. Edit (pencil): correct its details and rerun the checks. Reject (cross): exclude it from use while retaining the record. Undo: restore a rejected claim to its previous status.

reasons.High: High – every check passed, and the figure is found on the page
reasons.Analyst-entered: Analyst-entered – you entered this claim, so the app does not score it
reasons.Analyst-edited: Analyst-edited – you edited this claim, so the app does not score it
reasons.not matched: The app could not match this value to the cited cell.
reasons.no date: no period is stated for this figure
reasons.no unit: No unit or currency was identified. Check whether one is needed to interpret the figure.
reasons.no heading: The app could not identify a nearby label explaining what this figure measures.
reasons.not corroborated: No second occurrence of this figure was found in the deck. This does not establish whether the claim is accurate.
reasons.value not on page: The app could not match this value to the cited cell.
reasons.currency assumed: The app assigned a currency without an explicit currency label for this figure. Check the assumption.
reasons.unit assumed: The app assigned a unit without an explicit unit label for this figure. Check the assumption.
reasons.scenario label not on page: the scenario (best, realistic, worst) is not written near the figure
reasons.period not on page: the period is not written on the page
reasons.page out of range: the page cited does not exist in the document
reasons.use-of-funds share: This appears to show how funding will be allocated, rather than an operating forecast.
reasons.acquisition channel: This appears to describe a customer acquisition channel. Check whether it was classified under the correct metric.
reasons.turnover not revenue: the figure is turnover, which may not be revenue
reasons.year under bar differs: the year printed under the bar differs from the period given
reasons.pipeline column: This figure appears in a sales pipeline column. Check whether it has been incorrectly classified as revenue.
reasons.axis tick: the figure looks like a mark on a chart axis, not a claim
reasons.not a plan line: the line looks like funds raised or market data, not a plan figure
reasons.matches analyst claim: This may duplicate a claim you entered. Check the metric, value and period.
reasons.basis and scenario disagree: the basis (actual, projection) and the scenario do not fit together
reasons.basis conflicts with period: The actual/forecast classification may conflict with the assigned period. Check both.
reasons.cell corrected: the figure was found in a different cell than the one cited
reasons.sign not on page: the page prints no minus sign; the figure is shown as printed
reasons.period from page heading: the period comes from the page heading, not from the figure's own label
reasons.period from another cell: the period comes from another cell of the page, not from the figure's own cell
reasons.period is a range: The source gives a range of years. Check whether the figure applies to the whole range or a specific year.
reasons.growth dated to start year: The assigned period uses the starting year of the growth interval. Check which interval the growth figure covers.
reasons.label mismatch: the name of the figure is not next to it on the page
reasons.sources disagree: The linked sources assign different periods to this figure. Check whether they describe the same claim.
reasons.source ambiguous: more than one label or period fits this figure
reasons.source not associated: no label or period on the page can be tied to this figure
reasons.extraction incomplete: part of the page could not be read, so the figure may be elsewhere

year_label_below: the year label printed below the figure is {year}
